Why winterize your pond

Five steps, in the order they are done.

  1. 1Treat. Add a bacteria culture made for cold water so the biological filter keeps working as the temperature drops.
  2. 2Neutralize. Control ammonia while the pond is filtering less than it does in summer.
  3. 3Net. Cover the pond before the leaves drop, then lift the net once the trees are bare.
  4. 4Aerate. Keep oxygen moving into the water as the surface begins to close over.
  5. 5De-ice. Hold an opening in the ice through the coldest weeks.

A de-icer does not heat the pond. It keeps a hole open in the ice so oxygen gets in and gases get out. That is what lets the fish survive the winter.
